subject: Request: Quantified outcomes packet for upcoming Scopely renewal
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Reynolds <ethan.reynolds@scopely.com>, Tanya Singh <tanya.singh@scopely.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Quantified outcomes packet for upcoming Scopely renewal

Ethan / Tanya,

Hope youre well. As were getting ready for the renewal conversation in September, our renewal motion would be much stronger if we can present a short, quantified outcomes packet that ties the business impact back to Scopelys objectives. Specifically were hoping to capture a few verified metrics from the past 12 months:

- % change in retention (DAU/7-day) or engagement for targeted titles
- Average latency improvement (ms) observed after migration to the optimized runtime
- Estimated annualized cost savings (or % reduction in cost-per-inference)
- Any lift in monetization KPIs youre comfortable sharing (ARPU, conversion lift, etc.)

Ive attached a simple impact_template.xlsx to make it easy to drop numbers in and indicate if numbers are anonymized or public. Wed also love a short approval to publish a one-pager / case study with Scopely branding — if youre open to that, well share a draft before anything goes live.

If it helps, heres the timeline were proposing:
- Receive metrics + permission from you by Fri Jul 30
- Draft one-pager and share for review by Aug 6
- Finalize copy and legal review by Aug 20 (to support renewal packet)

Thanks for considering — I can jump on a quick 20-min call if you prefer to walk through the numbers together.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[d] +1 (415) 555-0128
[Attachment: impact_template.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)]

From: Ethan Reynolds <ethan.reynolds@scopely.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Tanya Singh <tanya.singh@scopely.com>
Cc: procurement@scopely.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 13:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Quantified outcomes packet for upcoming Scopely renewal

Dylan,

Thanks for the note and the template  appreciate the clear ask. Were happy to support and can share the following numbers on the record for Scopelys internal titles (you may quote these if we sign off on the final asset):

- Retention (7-day DAU): +18% (cohort of players exposed to the tuned LLM flows vs. baseline)
- Average inference latency: down from ~420ms to ~325ms (22% reduction)
- Cost per inference (normalized): ~35% reduction after batching + quantization changes; estimated annual savings \u00A4 $420,000 for active titles
- Small uplift in checkout conversion for personalized flows: +3.6% (stat sig across three campaigns)

Im attaching a short export that shows the summary tables and the latency report. Legal/procurement have been ccd for visibility; Kathryn in procurement will confirm any required wording for public assets. Wed like to review the final copy before publication, but otherwise happy to be a reference for the renewal.

Attachments: scopely_outcomes_jun2026.pdf (PDF, 320KB); latency_report_june.csv (CSV, 120KB)

- Ethan
Ethan Reynolds
Head of Growth Analytics | Scopely
ethan.reynolds@scopely.com
[Attachment: scopely_outcomes_jun2026.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]
[Attachment: latency_report_june.csv (CSV, 120KB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Reynolds <ethan.reynolds@scopely.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Quantified outcomes packet for upcoming Scopely renewal

Marissa / Laura,

Forwarding Ethans note and the attached export. Good news  theyre comfortable sharing the numbers and are open to a public asset pending a quick legal review.

Can you take point on drafting a one-page case study (visual + 3 bullets with the core metrics) and a short quote request for Ethans team? Proposed plan:
- One-pager draft in Drive by Mon Jul 26 (link below)
- Share with Ethan + procurement for approval by Aug 6
- Finalize and hook into renewal materials the week of Aug 23

Please flag if any of the numbers should be anonymized or require an addendum. Also copy in Legal if well need an approval form. Ill update the HubSpot deal with the outcomes so the AE motion shows the uplift.

Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bScopely-Impact-Docs]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Quantified outcomes packet for upcoming Scopely renewal

Thanks, Dylan  Ill take this. Draft attached: scopely_case_onepager_v1.docx.

Notes / next steps:
- I used Ethans numbers verbatim but added an "on-record after review" caveat; we should ask Kathryn (procurement) if they want specific attribution language.
- Suggest we anonymize the $420k estimated savings on the public one-pager and show % savings; show the raw dollar value in the renewal packet only (PDF behind sales login) unless Scopely explicitly signs off on public dollars.
- Ill include a short quote template for Ethan to approve to speed sign-off.
- Timeline: internal review by Mon Jul 26 EOD, then send to Ethan + Kathryn for approval on Tue Jul 27.

Att: scopely_case_onepager_v1.docx (Word, 75KB)

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
